title: Costco Rotisserie Chicken Remix
seoTitle: Costco Rotisserie Chicken Remix | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Creamy chicken-and-rice bake from store-bought birds
subtitle: Creamy chicken-and-rice bake from store-bought birds
description: Shredded chicken, rice, broccoli, and a creamy sauce bake under a crisp cheese topping.

steps.title: Heat oven and stage pans
steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease two deep hotel pans or casserole dishes so the rice bake releases cleanly after service. Set shredded chicken, rice, and broccoli within arm reach before mixing — hunting for pans mid-fold is how portions go uneven. Target oven/smoker temperature: 375°F.

steps.title: Pull chicken
steps.instruction: Remove meat from rotisserie chickens, discarding bones and checking for small cartilage pieces that can hide in dark meat. Shred into bite-size strips so every scoop gets chicken, not just rice.

steps.title: Steam broccoli
steps.instruction: Steam broccoli only until bright green and still crisp; it will finish in the oven. Soft olive broccoli sat too long and turns mushy in the bake.

steps.title: Mix sauce
steps.instruction: Whisk soup and milk until completely smooth so no concentrated salty pockets remain in the bake. Taste and add black pepper — rotisserie chicken already brings salt.

steps.title: Combine filling
steps.instruction: Fold rice, chicken, broccoli, and sauce together gently so the rice stays distinct instead of turning to porridge. Divide evenly between pans and level the surface.

steps.title: Cover and bake
steps.instruction: Cover with foil and bake until the centre of each pan reaches 165°F on an instant-read thermometer, about 25–30 minutes. Cold spots in the middle mean the pans were overfilled or the oven was crowded. Target oven/smoker temperature: 375°F.

steps.title: Add cheese
steps.instruction: Remove foil, blanket with cheddar, and bake uncovered 8–10 minutes until melted and lightly golden at the edges. Cheese burned black sat under the broiler too long. Target oven/smoker temperature: 375°F.

steps.title: Let the bake set
steps.instruction: Cover and wait 5 minutes so the sauce thickens enough to scoop clean portions without flooding the plate.

steps.title: Hold safely
steps.instruction: Cover loosely and hold above 140°F in a 200°F oven if the crew is delayed. Stir once before service if the edges look dry. Target oven/smoker temperature: 200°F.

steps.title: Scoop servings
steps.instruction: Use a large spoon to serve complete portions with chicken, rice, and broccoli in every scoop. Keep hot sauce and cracked pepper at the pass.

steps.title: Hold for call interruptions
steps.instruction: If tones drop mid-cook: turn off direct heat and cover rotisserie chicken bake — hold at 140°F in a warm cabinet or 200°F oven, never below 140°F for more than 30 minutes cumulative. Log hold time on the pan with a grease pencil. If tones drop after service, cover hot food and keep sides on low heat or ice as appropriate. On return, spot-check proteins at safe internal temp before reopening the line.

steps.title: Pack down leftovers safely
steps.instruction: Cool rotisserie chicken bake and hot components in shallow hotel pans within two hours — deep pots stay in the danger zone too long. Label with date; reheat proteins to 165°F minimum before second shift. Store cold components separately so textures survive overnight.

proTips: Use low-sodium soup because rotisserie chicken is seasoned.
Add crushed crackers only for the last bake.
tonightSpread: Condiments: hot sauce, black pepper, crushed crackers
Set hot components closest to the crew; cold crunch and toppings at the far end of the line.
Keep a backup tray at 200°F for firefighters returning from a run.
leftovers: Cool Rotisserie chicken in shallow pans within two hours; label with date and reheat to 165°F before second shift.
Store cold sides separately — hot and cold stacked overnight ruins texture.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Using cooked chicken cuts prep time sharply and stretches a grocery run into ten dinners.
mealPrepNotes: Make-ahead: assemble casserole 1 day ahead. Storage: refrigerate 3 days. Reheating: bake to 165°F in the centre.
substitutions: Use frozen mixed vegetables for broccoli.

adaptable.label: Gluten-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Thicken with cornstarch or a gluten-free flour blend instead of a wheat roux.
